summary: Verified fix for admin technician creation (JSON body) and test data cleanup. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed covering admin login, create technician via JSON body, list contains new tech, duplicate rejection, unauthorized rejection, new tech login, and absence of test_tech accounts. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow verified admin login, navigate to Tecnicos tab, click 'Novo Tecnico', fill form, submit, and confirm the newly created technician appears in the list; no leftover 'test_tech' accounts visible.
critical_code_review_comments: handleCreateTech in ConnectAdminDashboard.js does not send optional phone/specialties; endpoint accepts them so fine. Consider adding phone/specialties inputs in the Novo Tecnico modal for parity.
server.py is ~3145 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, technicians, subscriptions, calendar) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created several QA technicians (qa_tech_* and ui_qa_*@obelisco.pt) during testing; these are non-destructive and use unique uuid-based emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin tech creation now accepts JSON body {name,email,password,phone?,specialties?}. Endpoint POST /api/connect/admin/technicians returns {success, technician_id}. staff_users no longer contains test_tech_* accounts. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_technicians.py.
